liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Listener calls this version one of the best, noting its slow build to an epic jam [13]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer identifies the post-drums jam as the highlight, with everyone pitching in wonderfully [17]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer calls the jam into the Playing reprise the best they have ever heard [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-01-15.111592.mtx.chappell.sb32.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 171 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1979-01-15.nak300-rolfe.keshevan-wise.4669.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [2]
- **gd79-01-15.rolfe.wise-cohen.310.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 4.09/5 by 32 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer praises the sound quality as great for an audience recording twenty-five years old; Reviewer describes the indoor recording as having outdoor clarity and the snugness of walls [14][21]
- **gd1979-01-15.nak300.rolfe.miller.90100.flac24**: source not stated; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [4]
- **gd1979-01-15.nak300.rolfe.miller.90095.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes this is one of Keith and Donna's last shows together [14]
- Reviewer finds the transition between Miracle and Shakedown to be truly awesome and burning [16]
- Weir told the audience Phil was absent when the band started the second set [22]
- Reviewer states the show holds up well for 1979 and recommends grabbing the second set [15]
- Reviewer rates the show as hot, initially giving it four stars before being hooked [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-01-15.111592.mtx.chappell.sb32.flac16**: source: Sick Bits Vol. 32 - matrix by Chris Chappell; Source: SBD: (shnid 102389) via Charlie Miller; AUD: (shnid 90095) recorded by Steve Rolfe via Charlie Miller [1]. Also: Uploader credits Steve Rolfe and Charlie Miller for providing the source material [1]
- **gd1979-01-15.nak300-rolfe.keshevan-wise.4669.shnf**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Jim Wise;Rango Keshavan; source: Nakamichi 300's w/Cardoid Capsules > Master Audience Cassette > Sony TC158 [2]. Also: Steve Rolfe recorded from Section 61, Row S, Seat 7, using mics on PA and drums; Rango Keshavan transferred masters to DAT, and Jim Wise applied noise reduction and bass boost [2]
- **gd79-01-15.rolfe.wise-cohen.310.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steven Rolfe; source: Audience Recording: Nakamichi 300's w/Cardoid Capsules [3]. Also: Listener used DeadBase to identify the source of a filler tape containing the Miracle jam [18]
- **gd1979-01-15.nak300.rolfe.miller.90100.flac24**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 300/CP1 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXL-I90/Dolby B) D [4]. Also: Joe B. Jones assisted with pitch correction for this 24-bit 96k recording [4]
- **gd1979-01-15.nak300.rolfe.miller.90095.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 300/CP1 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXL-I90/Dolby B) D [5]. Also: Joe B. Jones assisted with pitch correction for this 16-bit recording [5]
